source.content: Account a1 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Id'); insert a1; Database.DeleteResult d1 = Database.delete(a1.Id); System.assert(d1.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult u1 = Database.undelete(a1.Id); System.assert(u1.isSuccess()); Account a2 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Id Boolean'); insert a2; Database.DeleteResult d2 = Database.delete(a2.Id, false); System.assert(d2.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult u2 = Database.undelete(a2.Id, false); System.assert(u2.isSuccess()); Account a3 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List'); Account a4 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List'); insert new List<Account>{a3, a4}; List<Id> ids1 = new List<Id>{a3.Id, a4.Id}; List<Database.DeleteResult> d3 = Database.delete(ids1); System.assertEquals(2, d3.size()); List<Database.UndeleteResult> u3 = Database.undelete(ids1); System.assertEquals(2, u3.size()); Account a5 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Boolean'); Account a6 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Boolean'); insert new List<Account>{a5, a6}; List<Id> ids2 = new List<Id>{a5.Id, a6.Id}; List<Database.DeleteResult> d4 = Database.delete(ids2, false); System.assertEquals(2, d4.size()); List<Database.UndeleteResult> u4 = Database.undelete(ids2, false); System.assertEquals(2, u4.size());
